exposure: Prolonged second stage of labour (present vs absent)
finding: Prolonged second stage of labour (PSSL) is associated with increased operative birth and maternal morbidity, but after adjusting for confounders, only five-minute Apgar scores ≤3 remained significantly increased.
mod_finding: Prolonged second stage of labor was associated with a lower likelihood of spontaneous vaginal delivery and a higher likelihood of instrumental delivery or emergency cesarean section.
